name: Pak Choi
grown_as: Chinese cabbage of the pak choi kind, cut whole or picked leaf by leaf. William's records list 'White Stem' and 'Red' (red-purple leaves with green stalks). Drawn as White Stem. ⚠️ CHECK.
habit: An upright, vase-shaped rosette 20 to 30 cm tall with no heart: broad leaf blades held on thick white stalks that overlap and swell into a bulbous base. Bolts readily in summer to 60 to 80 cm.

leaf.arrangement: A tight rosette, the stalks overlapping at the base; alternate and clasping on the flowering stem
leaf.outline: Spoon-shaped: a broad oval to round blade 10 to 20 cm long on a thick stalk
leaf.base: The blade narrows abruptly into the stalk, running a short way down it
leaf.veins: A broad white midrib running on from the stalk; side veins pale, branching into a net
leaf.surface: Smooth, glossy and hairless, flat or slightly crinkled
leaf.stalk: Thick, fleshy, crisp and flat to slightly cupped, white, widening at the base where it wraps the plant's centre, as long as the blade
leaf.colour: Dark glossy green blade, white stalks

flower.form: A cross-shaped flower of four petals
flower.petals: Four, free, oval with a narrow claw, spreading flat
flower.centre: Six stamens, four long and two short, with yellow anthers
flower.carried: In spikes at the top of the branched bolted stem; the newly opened flowers are held above the closed buds, so the top of each spike is flat
flower.season: March to May from overwintered plants, or in summer when it bolts

fruit: Slender pods 3 to 6 cm, cylindrical with a slight bump over each seed, ending in a thin beak 1 to 2 cm, held upright-spreading on stalks along the stem. Green, drying straw-brown and splitting from the bottom to show a pale papery partition. Seeds round, 1.5 mm, red-brown to dark brown.
seedling: Two kidney-shaped seed leaves on short stalks, broader than long with a notch at the tip, like a heart with the stalk at its point, then rounded true leaves on pale stalks.
winter: Nothing in the open (sown spring to late summer); hardy kinds last under cover.

leaf: a broad, smooth, rounded dark glossy blade
a thick flat white stalk as long as the blade
a white midrib carrying on from the stalk
bloom: four bright yellow petals in a cross
open flowers held above the closed buds
seedling: two kidney-shaped seed leaves notched at the tip
young: a small upright rosette of spoon-shaped leaves on white stalks
crop: an upright vase-shaped rosette with no heart
thick white stalks overlapping into a swollen base
flower: a branched stem with clasping leaves
bright yellow flowers in flat-topped spikes
seedhead: slender beaked pods upright along the stems

look_alikes: Chinese cabbage (napa) makes a tall closed heart of crinkled pale leaves. Swiss chard has puckered leaves and a long-lived crown. Tatsoi is a flat rosette of small spoon-shaped leaves.
